name: Rosewood Bangkok
positioning: 30-storey hotel tower in Bangkok whose architecture is inspired by the wai, the Thai gesture of greeting, with Thai, Chinese, farm-to-table and vinyl speakeasy venues
best_for: Travelers who want a high-rise Bangkok base with city and skyline views
Food and drink lovers drawn to Thai cooking classes, Thai wine tastings and a vinyl speakeasy
Guests wanting a House with dedicated butler service and a plunge pool

facts.text: Rosewood Bangkok has four dining venues: Thai, Chinese, farm-to-table and a vinyl speakeasy.
Lennon's serves signature cocktails inspired by music.
Nan Bei, meaning South and North in Mandarin, serves Chinese cuisine in an art deco interior.
Lakorn serves dishes from Thailand's four culinary regions alongside classic European dishes.
Lakorn is decorated with traditional Thai artistry and has skyline views.
G&O is a farm-to-table cafe for lunch and brunch, with an emphasis on locally grown organic and natural ingredients.
Guestrooms have modern interiors and panoramic city views.
Half-day tours of the Songwat community cover historic sites, art, local food and Thai desserts.
The Fitness Studio has Technogym equipment and views of the Bangkok skyline.
The hotel's spa is Sense, a Rosewood Spa.
Lennon's offers a cocktail masterclass covering two of its recipes, with non-alcoholic class options available.

highlights.text: Rosewood Bangkok is a 30-storey vertical tower whose architecture is inspired by the wai, the Thai gesture of greeting.
Lennon's is a speakeasy and vinyl bar with a 6,000-piece vinyl collection.
The hotel's Houses come with dedicated butler service, plunge pools and skyline views.
A sommelier-guided Thai wine tasting at Lakorn features six wines from GranMonte Vineyards in Khao Yai.
Mama Bua leads a Thai cooking class at Lakorn exploring the cuisine of Thailand's Northern, Southern or Eastern regions.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes a high-rise urban setting in a busy commercial district.
The pool is an indoor and outdoor saltwater lap pool, located between the Fitness Studio and G&O.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
